title: The phylogenetic rank of a graph
summary: The Pachter-Sturmfels phylogenetic rank of a graph G is the minimal number of metric trees needed to embed G isometrically. Here, all edges of G are of length one and the product of metric trees is endowed with the supremum norm. We develop both a greedy and an exact algorithm for computing phylogenetic ranks. Using our algorithms, we construct a database of phylogenetic ranks which includes all graphs on 6 and 7 vertices.
